title: Tool Adapters
summary: This module provides adapters for integrating various external tools and data sources, such as enterprise action kits, LanceDB, and RAG systems, into the CrewAI framework.

nodes.label: Enterprise Action Kit Adapter
nodes.title: EnterpriseActionKitToolAdapter
nodes.description: Adapts enterprise-defined actions into usable BaseTool instances, fetching action schemas from an API and generating detailed tool descriptions.

nodes.label: LanceDB Adapter
nodes.title: LanceDBAdapter
nodes.description: Provides an interface to LanceDB for vector-based search and data addition, utilizing an embedding function for queries.

nodes.label: RAG Adapter
nodes.title: RAGAdapter
nodes.description: Integrates with a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system for querying and adding data, configurable with different embedding models and API keys.

nodes.label: Tool Definitions
nodes.title: Tool Definitions
nodes.description: Defines the structure and behavior of various tools available within the CrewAI ecosystem.

nodes.label: RAG System
nodes.title: RAG System
nodes.description: Manages the core Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) functionalities, including embedding, indexing, and retrieval.

groups.label: Tool Integration
groups.title: Tool Integration
groups.description: Components responsible for adapting various external tools and data sources into a standardized format for use within the system.
